info.prompt: Extreme close-up of a player's hand hovering over a Wild Blocker tile with rainbow hue-shifting borders, casting prismatic reflections across the gothic skeletal interface, while the surrounding board tiles subtly vibrate with anticipation, their faces hidden until selection but faintly glowing in respective gem colors (gold for ones, steel-blue for fives), with a depleting crimson bomb fuse timer reflected in the player's retina.
